verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents on-reader tipping, where the card reader suggests tips to customers before collecting payment, and it can collect tips before or after authorization. That covers the core of the story. However, the evidence never shows how merchants configure the prompts. Missing for 10: documented configuration of tip percentages, smart/fixed tip amounts, a custom-tip entry option, a merchant-facing configuration surface (Dashboard or API) for tipping settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal
